description: This file defines the 'File' class within the OpenCart System Session library. It handles session management by reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session files stored on the server. The class interacts with session files located in a specified directory and provides mechanisms for session persistence and cleanup.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Handles file-based session management, including reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collection of session files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session file handler with the application's registry to access configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from a file based on the given session ID; returns an array of session data.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to a file with the specified session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file identified by the session ID, effectively destroying the session.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting expired session files based on configuration parameters.
